name: DiscoSense
description: We present DiscoSense, a benchmark for commonsense reasoning via understanding a wide variety of discourse connectives. We generate compelling distractors in DiscoSense using Conditional Adversarial Filtering, an extension of Adversarial Filtering that employs conditional generation. We show that state-of-the-art pre-trained language models struggle to perform well on DiscoSense, which makes this dataset ideal for evaluating next-generation commonsense reasoning systems.
reputation: A specialized commonsense reasoning benchmark that has seen some use in evaluating pretrained language models, but is not as widely adopted as major NLP benchmarks.
notes: Multiple-choice commonsense benchmark; likely susceptible to dataset artifacts despite adversarial filtering, and community adoption is moderate rather than broad.
